messages:
alice.l: Kicking off the staggered region rollout for release v2.3.1 now. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC, 20m between region ramps. Please post capacity checks for each region and flag any hotspots. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout v2.3.1: regions=[us, eu, apac], stagger=20m, canary=5%, fallback=auto-pin-to-v2.3.0. Rollout window: 02:00-08:00 UTC. Initiating canary in US in 2m.

ben.s: US capacity check: current reserved GPUs 48, avg p95 latency 85ms, free slot headroom ~12 nodes if autoscaler spins. No known maintenance. Can hit +30% for short bursts.

alice.l: Good. Ben, please watch KV cache saturation on seq len 1024 prompts during canary. If p95 > 200ms, hold and notify.

ops-bot: KV cache util snapshot (last 5m): us=62%, eu=45%, apac=31%.

sam: EU capacity: 32 reserved GPUs, p95 110ms with current traffic, but we have a scheduled batch job at 03:15 UTC that might spike. Recommend pin EU routing to v2.3.0 during that job window or delay EU ramp by 30m.

alice.l: Let's delay EU ramp by 30m and set pin fallback policy to v2.3.0 for EU. Deploy-bot, set region policy.

deploy-bot: Updating rollout: eu_delay=+30m, eu_fallback=v2.3.0 pinned. Canary US starting in 30s.

mike_k: APAC note: some regions in APAC are on smaller instance types right now (nitro-xx-small). If we push full traffic we may saturate before autoscaler can add capacity. Suggest initial APAC canary at 2% with stricter token-rate throttle.

alice.l: Agreed. APAC canary 2% and token throttle of 50req/s per shard until warm. Sam/Tanya please confirm scaling policies are applied.

ops-bot: Applied throttle: apac=50req/s/shard. Canary sizes: us=5%, eu=0% (delayed), apac=2%.

ben.s: US canary started -> p50=60ms p95=120ms p99=270ms. CPU avg 72%. No errors. Monitoring KV evictions.

tanya: Watching KV evictions. Patch applied to reduce prefix cache retention for this rollout; should lower mem pressure.

sam: EU hold confirmed. Will re-evaluate at EU ramp time +10m.

deploy-bot: US canary at 5% -> passed smoke checks. Rolling US to 30% now over 10m ramp. If any region crosses error_rate > 1% or p95 > 300ms, automated hold will trigger.

alice.l: Reminder: rollback playbook on page ops/runbooks/rollbacks.md — if US p99 > 500ms or error spikes >2% for 5m, trigger immediate rollback. Ben/Tanya own the first 10m of post-rollout checks.

ben.s: Noted. Adding quick check list in thread: 1) p95 across shards 2) error-rate by model 3) autoscaler event count 4) KV eviction rate.

mike_k: APAC throttle in place and canary initiated at 2% -> initial p95 140ms, tokens/sec nominal. Autoscaler hasn't fired (expected), but node headroom still available in region pool.

deploy-bot: EU ramp now scheduled in +30m from thread start (1767654321). Will post status at start.

alice.l: If anyone sees sustained p95 degradation during EU ramp, hold and we'll pin EU to v2.3.0 and open a rollback call. Otherwise proceed with the staggered plan. :eyes:

ops-bot: Status update (10m): us=30% rollout, p95=130ms, errors=0.4%, eu=delayed, apac=2% p95=145ms, errors=0.2%.

sam: EU batch job finished early; sched job back to nominal. I recommend starting EU ramp at +18m rather than full +30m. Will confirm in 5.

alice.l: Ok — proceed with +18m if safe. Keep fallback pinned to v2.3.0 for first 10m of EU ramp.

deploy-bot: EU ramp update: new_delay=+18m, eu_fallback_window=10m pinned to v2.3.0.

ops-bot: Final check (20m): us=fully rolled, p95 steady 125ms, errors=0.3%. apac ramp to 10% in progress, autoscaler triggered +2 nodes, no evictions. EU ramp scheduled soon.

alice.l: Thanks team — will monitor for next 40m. If anything trips thresholds we follow rollback playbook. Otherwise we'll capture rollout notes for release notes and close the window. :white_check_mark:
